versions.changelog:
v2.0.1 patch.
- Removed name-specific reference to a third-party agent system in the intro line
- Clarified gray zone in grounding requirement: <3 = experimental (do not publish); 3-9 = beta (single-user only); ≥10 = ready for public publish
- Updated agent-harness reference to use the actual published slug 'trinity-harness'

v2.0.0 — major upgrade based on 30+ skill creation incidents over 2 months.

Breaking:
- Quality gate expanded from 3 questions (Novel/Successful/Reusable) to 4 (+ Grounded ≥10 real samples)

New sections:
- 4-Layer Quality Check (Format / Grounding / IP Boundary / Discoverability)
- Skill Classification (Internal / Preparing / Shared / External)
- Pre-Publish Vet for public registries (IP grep, injection scan, vet, SSOT update)
- Skill hash drift detection (anti-supply-chain attack)
- Trigger keyword discipline (5-15 concrete user phrases, multilingual if needed)

Updated:
- 'Sycophancy of Completeness' anti-pattern: polished-looking skills with 0 grounding
- Auto-distillation must announce, never silent
- Update vs. Create: explicit check across multiple skills directories
- IP Boundary check guards against leaking private identifiers/paths to public registries

Why: v1's 3-question gate let skills slip through that *looked* reusable but were LLM-hallucinated. v2 requires real samples + IP discipline + SSOT tracking before any public publish.

Initial release: Auto-distill successful workflows into reusable skills. Three-gate quality filter (Novel+Successful+Reusable), 5-step distillation process, anti-bloat mechanisms, memory system integration.
